sourceAudit.conclusion: Current patch chain does not modify SIGNAL_GRADE_A_MIN=80, SIGNAL_GRADE_B_MIN=65, or the channel-specific setupQuality formulas.

structuralClaims: B.pass boundary constraints imply setupQuality>=69.65, so B cannot become signalGrade C at the final-grade gate.
A.pass can coexist with setupQuality<65, so final-grade rejection is an effective A-only gate under current formulas.
For A with volumeTodayVsPrev5>0.9, maximum setupQuality is 74, so signalGrade A is unreachable.
Strategy channel A/B and signal grade A/B/C are distinct semantics and must not be pooled as if the letters mean the same thing.
inferenceGuard: This is structural reachability, not outcome quality. It does not prove the A final-grade gate is harmful or should be relaxed.
exactNext: Audit what can be measured from full-scan diagnostics versus bounded Shadow. Use full first-failure count for same-day FINAL_GRADE incidence, but do not interpret it as causal benefit of removing the gate. Long-run promotion-grade evidence still requires immutable decision receipts.
